heard: Early on the first day, at the breaking of the dawn Early in the morning, the women walked to see the tomb There every hope was gone Early in the morning, then the earth began to tremble And the guards became like dead men Early in the morning An angel rolled the stone away And sat upon it then Early in the morning Do not be afraid I know that you are looking for Jesus He is not here He has risen Just as He said Come and see the place where he lay He is not here He has risen
